dedupe_keys.name: hospital digital twin simpy ward simulation with pycaret machine learning models anshsinghal29

description: An open source digital twin of a hospital ward that pairs a SimPy discrete-event simulation with a PyCaret machine learning pipeline, following a research workflow document for building hospital digital twins from public datasets. Scripts generate synthetic data (500 patients, 27 clinical features, vitals), clean it, and train five models: length of stay regression, in-hospital mortality classification, patient phenotype clustering, ED arrival forecasting and deterioration anomaly detection. The README reports a length of stay error of 1.65 days, mortality AUC of 0.69, and a validation in which simulated and historical length of stay pass a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test, with sensitivity checks on arrival rates. A Streamlit dashboard supports what-if scenario analysis. Coverage: one generic ward, no named hospital. Access: free GitHub repository, no licence file. Caveats: results are on synthetic data, so they show the workflow and not clinical performance. Useful for capacity planning simulation and prototyping a ward digital twin; related records are not yet linked.
